Published the miles_cp_collective_desync_deadlock task at the issue level: ten judgments (ten models; no Gemini run), recorded 20 Nov 2026 from the local cybertron-evaluate sweep. No pass. Published the verl_inventory_agent_compound task at the issue level: ten judgments (ten models; no Gemini run), recorded 21 Nov 2026 from the local cybertron-evaluate sweep. No pass. The task pins a five-way compound fault in a tool-use inventory GRPO run: timeout-affected orders retry with a fresh key and apply the mutation twice, released stock keeps paying progress reward that the training clamps leave negative-side free, ordinary validation draws from the training order families, and the step-10 restart binds 294 populated AdamW moments to the wrong parameters -- while mean reward rises (0.977 to 1.024) and every validation curve saturates at 100%, so the clean metrics mask the faults; timeout-enabled training trajectories hold 0/48 strict success against 360/360 in the paired repaired run. Published the verl_vllm011_fp8_kv_scale_sleep task at the issue level: ten judgments (ten models; no Gemini run), recorded 22 Nov 2026 from the local cybertron-evaluate sweep. No pass. The task pins verl's level-2 vLLM sleep: on wake-up, load_weights() pushes the actor checkpoint back but never restores vLLM 0.11's per-layer fp8 KV-cache scales (_k_scale/_v_scale drop to 0), so every response decodes as "!" repeated to the 16,384-token cap with reward and gradient exactly zero from step 1 -- while the host-side scale mirror stays 1.0 and the entropy looks normal, so the logs read like a temperature or precision problem; 224 of 256 step-1 responses are only "!" (the remaining 32 are 87-99.98% "!"), and the auto-KV control arm scores 0.832/0.789/0.777 against the recorded arm's three zeros. Every model returns the correct verdict; GLM-5.3 (0.66), Claude-Fable-5.1 (0.634), Kimi-K3.1-Pro (0.607) and GPT-6.1-Sol (0.58) reach root cause 0.5, the other six hold zero root-cause credit. The task ships issue-only.

Published the verl_fsdp_bucketed_weight_sync task at both levels: ten issue judgments and ten solution runs (ten models; no Gemini run), recorded 22 Nov 2026 from the local cybertron-evaluate sweep. No pass at either level. The task pins two mutually masking bugs in an FSDP2 GRPO run: build_optimizer overwrites a (device, dtype, ndim) dict and collapses 338 trainable parameters into 2, while BucketedWeightReceiver.receive_weights fires on_bucket_received outside the receive loop so only the last weight bucket loads into vLLM -- the 2 surviving parameters happen to sit in that last bucket, so ppo_kl stays near zero and update_weights reports done every step while held-out accuracy moves only 0.0117 to 0.0410 in 45 steps against 0.4658 in the control. Issue side: GLM-5.3 (0.6) is the only model with root-cause credit (0.5, the optimizer half); four models misjudge the run healthy; the Claude-Fable-5.1 run ends without a deliverable. Solution side: five runs change nothing and record deterministic zeros, one ends without a report, and the replayed repairs all grade 0 -- the two defects must both be fixed for the gate.

Published the verl_grpo_grouped_whiten_order task at both levels: ten issue judgments and ten solution runs (ten models; no Gemini run), recorded 22 Nov 2026 from the local cybertron-evaluate sweep. No pass at either level. The task pins two compounding gradient bugs in a GRPO run: grouped_whiten indexes standardized advantages with the forward sort order instead of inverting it, so trajectories receive each other\u2019s advantages, and kl_penalty routes low_var_kl into a straight-through branch that squares the sequence-summed log-ratio -- forward actor/kl_loss looks small and clean while backward KL gradients overwhelm policy updates and hold step-50 accuracy at 0.4610 against 0.5588. Issue side: every model returns the correct verdict, but only Claude-Fable-5.1, Kimi-K3.1-Pro and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash reach root cause 0.5, each naming one of the two defects, and no model joins both. Solution side: four deterministic zeros for unchanged workspaces and sixteen replayed repairs that grade 0 -- again both defects must be fixed.

Published the trl_gsm8k_threaded_reward_order task at the issue level: ten judgments (ten models; no Gemini run), recorded 22/23 Nov 2026 from the local cybertron-evaluate sweep. Four passes. The task pins a race in the vendored TRL's local reward_num_workers path: reward functions run on batch slices in a thread pool and the slices are concatenated with concurrent.futures.as_completed, so scores come back in finish order and the trainer attaches them to the wrong completions -- reward decays 0.066 to 0.001 while held-out accuracy falls 0.017 to 0.000 against a 0.75 control. Qwen3.8-Max, Kimi-K3.1-Pro, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash and Claude-Fable-5.1 pass at 1.0; GLM-5.3 (0.95) and Grok-4.7 (0.943) hold the full root cause but fall at the evidence gate; Kimi-K3 reproduces the mismatched numbers without naming the mechanism; GPT-6.1-Sol, GPT-6-Astra and DeepSeek-V4-Pro return the correct verdict with zero root-cause credit. The task ships issue-only.
